quest.name: Clear the Road
quest.description: Rook wants the road cleared of normal ghouls.

talk.text: Kill 3 normal ghouls, then come back and tell me about the {ghouls}. The pay is 250 caps.

stage.journal: Defeat 3 normal ghouls, then report to Rook.

objective.reply: The road is safer. Here are 250 caps.

ending.journal: You cleared the road and received 250 caps from Rook.

reply.text: The ghouls are still out there. Kill 3, then tell me about the {ghouls}.
